BEGIN;
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_planning_state_inbox_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hybrid_planning_state_inbox FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_evaluation_job_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hybrid_evaluation_job FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_evaluation_immutable();
CREATE TABLE hybrid_consequence_work (
 job_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hybrid_evaluation_job(id),
 completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 claim_token uuid NULL,
 lease_until timestamptz NULL,
 next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 CHECK((claim_token IS NULL)=(lease_until IS NULL)),
 CHECK(NOT completed OR claim_token IS NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX hybrid_consequence_work_pending_idx ON hybrid_consequence_work(next_attempt_at) WHERE NOT completed;
CREATE TABLE hybrid_consequence_input (
 job_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hybrid_evaluation_job(id),
 input_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(input_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 inputs_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(inputs_json)='object'),
 pinned_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
CREATE TABLE hybrid_consequence_receipt (
 job_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hybrid_evaluation_job(id),
 consequence_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 payload_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(payload_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 consequence_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(consequence_json)='object'),
 committed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 CHECK(consequence_json->>'consequence_id'=consequence_id::text)
);
CREATE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'hybrid consequence policy inputs and receipts are immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_consequence_input_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON hybrid_consequence_input FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_consequence_receipt_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON hybrid_consequence_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_consequence_input_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hybrid_consequence_input FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_consequence_receipt_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hybrid_consequence_receipt FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable();
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_consequence_input IS 'First pinned existing Planner policy and bounded published prerequisite projection. Retries use these exact immutable inputs.';
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_consequence_receipt IS 'One immutable deterministic semantic result per coherent snapshot-policy job. This receipt cannot mutate Student.';
COMMIT;
